meta.note: Reference data for verifying the lectionary implementation. "text" is the source wording of the day's readings block; "refs" are all references parsed from it in order (Liturgy, Matins, saints — not only the ordinary readings). Compare: our main Gospel must be in refs of the same day (or of the previous/next day when a saint's feast moved the ordinary reading).

sources.azbyka_roc: https://azbyka.ru/days/<date> (Russian Orthodox Church calendar; readings published for 2024-01-01..2027-01-09 at fetch time)
sources.ocu: https://www.pomisna.info/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/bogosluzhbovi-vkazivky-2026.pdf (OCU, New Julian; parsed from PDF text, some days unparsed)
sources.pravoslavie_roc: https://days.pravoslavie.ru/Days/<JULIAN yyyymmdd>.html (Sretensky monastery calendar, ROC; windows Sep 10-Oct 25 and Dec 15-Mar 5 of 2017-2023, full 2024)
